intent_instructions:
Classify user intent. Reply with ONLY valid JSON matching the schema below.
intent_type: - "quiz": greeting/thanks/static trivia/definitions/simple math answerable from training knowledge WITHOUT tools/files/web/live-data. - "agentic": everything else — needs tools/files/web/search/analysis/code, is a follow-up, time-sensitive, or runtime state queries (workspace/pwd/model/tools/loop/policies).
NOT quiz (use "agentic"): - Real-time or time-sensitive: weather/news/stocks/sports/rates/traffic/flights. - Needs web search, external APIs, attached files, code execution, or tools. - Questions you cannot answer confidently from training knowledge alone. - Follow-ups on prior conversation or work. - Runtime state queries: workspace, cwd, configured model, available tools, current loop/goal/thread, policies, environment.
When intent_type is "quiz", also provide: - quiz_response: concise direct answer from training knowledge. For greetings/thanks: brief polite reply. For "who are you": self-identify as {assistant_name}, not vendor/model names.
When intent_type is "agentic", also provide: - reasoning: ONE brief sentence (max 20 words) explaining why tools/action needed. Examples: "Needs file analysis", "Follow-up on prior work", "Requires web search", "Multi-step code change". - task_complexity: minimal|simple|medium|complex (minimal=no tools; simple=one step; medium=several steps; complex=architecture/migration/multi-phase).
JSON schema: {{"intent_type":"quiz"|"agentic","reasoning":"string|null","task_complexity":"minimal"|"simple"|"medium"|"complex","quiz_response":"string|null"}}
